caption: Idealised crack patterns of a simply supported reinforced-concrete beam under four-point loading: flexural, shear and flexure-shear. P is a load, a the shear span, d the effective depth. A drawing, not data.
strings:
Flexure cracks stay vertical, shear cracks slant toward the load, and flexure-shear cracks start
vertical then bend.
Source: schematic of the three classes used for 295 images
